overview: Jiutian Xuannv is a Legendary Archer of the Clubs faction whose kit centers on a dual-stance system that reads the battlefield and adapts. She is not a simple burst DPS - instead she operates as a board-control archer who toggles between Execute stance (focused single-target pressure with stacking ATK) and Yield stance (weakest-target cleanup) depending on the unit-count state.

Her Ultimate functions as a state manager, not a nuke. Her passive system designates frontline and backline allies as chess pieces, granting damage bonus and damage reduction respectively. Her active skill disrupts enemy energy cycles while regenerating her own. Her defensive passive converts incoming damage into a counter-attack burst via the Taiji Formation.

The CN community describes her as a strong card for Clubs Tower (梅花塔), push content, and high-damage ranking scenarios - but notes she is team-dependent and more investment-sensitive than simpler carries. Played correctly, she can exceed comparable archers in specific high-damage setups. Played blindly, she underperforms.
Guide data sourced from CN community posts and official skill previews on TapTap CN (不朽箴言). Released on CN server March 6, 2026. Numerical stats not yet available.

lore.label: Nine Heavens Mysterious Lady - Chinese Mythology
lore.intro: Jiutian Xuannv (九天玄女) is a celestial goddess from Chinese mythology - a divine strategist who advised the Yellow Emperor in his wars against Chi You. She embodies cosmic order, military wisdom, and the principle that a superior strategist reads the entire battlefield before making a single move. The game draws directly on these themes for her mechanical identity.
bullets: Win Half Against Heaven (胜天半子) channels her role as the celestial advisor who tips the scales - not by brute force but by reading when to press and when to yield
Swift Control, Slow Response (速御迟) reflects her doctrine of strategic patience: designate your pieces, control the board, and let position determine outcome
Tactical Interception (插制巧) is the art of disrupting the enemy's flow - seizing energy when they are weak and draining it when they are strong
Enter the Game (身入局) embodies her most famous principle: true mastery requires placing oneself within the situation, not outside it - she absorbs the threat and returns it
The Relic, Strike the Void, Hit the Real (虚击实), is the crown of her strategic philosophy: appear to strike empty air, and land on the real target

coreMechanic.sectionTitle: Core Mechanic - The Execute / Yield Stance System
coreMechanic.label: How the Stance System Works
bullets: At battle start, Jiutian Xuannv begins in Yield stance (执白) by default.
Her passive Swift Control, Slow Response designates the frontmost ally as the White piece (damage received reduced) and the rearmost ally as the Black piece (damage dealt increased).

Her Ultimate reads the current unit count: if friendly units ≥ enemies, she switches to Execute stance + ATK Speed buff. If enemies outnumber friendlies, she switches to Yield stance + ATK Speed buff.
Execute stance (执黑): Attacks the current target and builds an ATK bonus with every hit, up to a cap. Favors focused single-target ramp damage.
Yield stance (执白): Attacks the weakest enemy. Functions as a cleanup and pickoff tool - excellent for removing low-HP targets and exposed backline units.
The White and Black piece designations can swap once per field when positional thresholds are crossed - triggering a shield based on Jiutian's ATK at Skill Lv3.

highlightBox.label: Why Positioning Is Non-Negotiable
bullets: The White/Black piece system fires based on physical position at battle start. Incorrect frontline or backline slot assignments misfires the buffs - potentially giving damage reduction to a carry and damage bonus to a tank.
The Ultimate's stance switch depends on live unit count - team deaths shift her mode. In a losing fight she may move to Yield (cleanup) at exactly the moment more burst pressure is needed.
CN community notes this is the single most important hidden mechanic for getting full value from her. Do not auto-slot her into random positions.

skills.name: Win Half Against Heaven
skills.description: Reads the battlefield and switches stance based on unit count. If friendly unit count ≥ enemy unit count: switches to Execute stance and grants an ATK Speed boost. If friendly unit count < enemy unit count: switches to Yield stance and grants an ATK Speed boost.

upgrades.text: Deals damage to all enemy units equal to a percentage of their highest ATK.
Execute stance grants a greater ATK increase per hit.
Yield stance additionally grants a basic attack damage boost for a duration.

skills.note: The Ultimate is a state manager, not a damage nuke. Cast it to set the correct stance for the current battlefield phase - Execute while winning for ramp damage; Yield while behind for cleanup. Lv2 adds an AoE damage component that partially compensates for the lack of a traditional nuke payload.

skills.name: Strike the Void, Hit the Real
skills.description: Strengthens both stances. Execute: Each attack additionally deals bonus damage based on own ATK and the target's max HP (capped). Yield: The first attacks after entering Yield stance deal bonus damage based on own ATK and the target's lost HP (capped).

upgrades.text: When Enter the Game activates and hits are received, gains energy and resets the formation cooldown (proc chance).
The Enter the Game cooldown reset becomes guaranteed instead of chance-based.
Execute and Yield stance damage ratios and upper limits are further increased.

skills.note: Lv1 is immediately impactful - bonus damage in both stances is felt right away. Lv3 is the major functional breakpoint: the Enter the Game cooldown reset shifts from probabilistic to guaranteed, making her defensive conversion loop far more reliable. CN players rate the Lv3 upgrade as high-value.

skills.name: Swift Control, Slow Response
skills.description: At battle start, designates the frontmost ally as the White piece (damage received reduced) and the rearmost ally as the Black piece (damage dealt increased). When White advances into enemy territory it converts to Black; when Black is approached by an enemy it converts to White. Each swap triggers once per field.

upgrades.text: Black piece damage bonus percentage increased.
When a unit swaps designation, it gains a shield based on a percentage of Jiutian's ATK.
White piece damage reduction effect increased.

skills.note: Fires at battle start with no action required. Its entire value is positional - wrong slot assignment negates the benefit. Run a dedicated frontline tank and a dedicated backline carry to ensure the correct designations land. Lv3 adds a shield on designation swap, giving whoever repositions first a meaningful survivability layer.

skills.name: Tactical Interception
skills.description: Fires at multiple targets nearest to her, dealing ATK-based damage (hits the same target multiple times if fewer targets than projectiles). Energy comparison determines secondary effect: if target's energy is below Jiutian's, she recovers her own energy. If target's energy is equal to or above hers, she drains the target's energy.

upgrades.text: Energy recovered when target energy is below Jiutian's is further increased.
Energy drained when target energy is equal to or above Jiutian's is further increased.
Energy drain when target energy is equal to or above Jiutian's becomes significantly larger.

skills.note: More than raw damage - this skill adds genuine energy disruption. Against high-energy-rotation enemies (bosses, energy-cycling supports), the drain side becomes extremely valuable. The self-recovery side accelerates her own Ultimate cadence in early-fight phases. Upgrade priority increases in sustained PvE content where energy denial compounds over multiple rotations.

skills.name: Enter the Game
skills.description: When Jiutian Xuannv receives an attack, she summons the Taiji Formation. During the formation, all incoming damage is 100% nullified and accumulated. After the formation ends, she fires at the nearest enemy dealing the accumulated total as her attack. This skill has a cooldown.

upgrades.text: Continuously gains higher damage nullification during the formation.

skills.note: A defensive-to-offensive converter. She does not simply tank hits - she stores them and fires them back. Against enemies who cannot burst her down in one rotation, she generates additional damage from their own aggression. Benefits from controlled, medium-duration exchanges. Hard one-shots before the formation triggers waste this mechanic entirely.

skillUpgradePriority: 1. Win Half Against Heaven (Ultimate) - State-management core; Lv2 AoE and Lv3 Execute bonus are both meaningful upgrades
2. Strike the Void, Hit the Real (Relic) - Lv3 guaranteed Enter the Game reset is the single largest power spike in her kit
3. Tactical Interception - Energy drain at Lv4 becomes a major disruption tool in sustained PvE
4. Swift Control, Slow Response - Lv3 shield on designation swap adds survivability to the positional loop
5. Enter the Game - Cooldown reductions matter but are partially covered by Relic Lv2/3 anyway

paragraphs: Jiutian Xuannv must occupy the rearmost position to receive the Black piece designation from Swift Control, Slow Response. In this slot she gains increased damage dealt - directly amplifying her Execute stance ramp, Tactical Interception damage, and Enter the Game counter-strike output.

If she is not in the rearmost position, the Black piece designation falls on a different unit (likely a support or tank), wasting the damage bonus and denying her the most important passive buff in her kit.
Front: Dedicated tank or bruiser - receives the White piece designation (damage received reduced), ensuring the frontline survives longer to maintain board presence for Execute stance triggers.
Mid: Utility supports, energy accelerators, or CC heroes that extend fight duration and enable Jiutian's energy manipulation cycle.
Back: Jiutian Xuannv in the rearmost slot. Formation structure must be intentional - random slot assignment breaks the entire White/Black designation system.

strengths: Flexible dual-stance system adapts to board state automatically - Execute for ramp, Yield for cleanup
Energy manipulation via Tactical Interception adds genuine disruption value beyond raw damage, especially in boss and PvE content
Enter the Game converts enemy aggression into counter-damage, punishing sustained multi-hit patterns
Scales strongly in longer PvE fights where mode cycling, energy drain compounding, and Relic bonuses all have time to stack
High relevance in Clubs Tower (梅花塔) and push content - CN community explicitly notes she reduces difficulty there
Relic offers clear functional breakpoints: immediate damage at Lv1, reliable defensive loop at Lv3
CN reports suggest she can exceed comparable carries in specific high-damage ranking setups
weaknesses: Heavily position-dependent - White/Black piece designation requires intentional team construction; cannot be blind-slotted
Team-dependent as a carry; CN community notes she requires significant investment and teammate support as a solo carry
Enter the Game is bypassed by hard one-shot burst before the Taiji Formation activates
Stance switch logic is automated by unit count - in a losing fight she may enter Yield mode when Execute pressure is more needed
PvP ceiling less established than PvE; CN sources focus primarily on tower and boss content
Underperforms early game without proper positioning and team support in place

entries.name: Pan
entries.text: Cited in CN challenge guides as a mandatory partner in Jiutian's time-limited challenge stages. Pan's crowd control layers with Jiutian's energy drain to slow enemy ultimate rotations. AoE CC also gives the Taiji Formation time to cycle before enemies can focus Jiutian down.

entries.name: Jormungandr
entries.text: Repeatedly featured in CN Clubs Tower team compositions alongside Jiutian. DoT damage compounds naturally with the longer fight durations Jiutian's energy manipulation and mode cycling create. Both heroes benefit from extended PvE encounters rather than short burst windows.

entries.name: Nezha
entries.text: CN community explicitly describes Jiutian and Nezha as "quite useful together." Nezha provides consistent front-loaded burst pressure that pairs with Jiutian's ranged stance-switching output - two different damage vectors operating simultaneously without competing for the same resources.

entries.name: Anubis
entries.text: Present in the CN zero-spender Clubs Tower team lineup alongside Jiutian. His targeting logic and CC patterns create controlled fight conditions where Jiutian's positional designation system and stance switches function as intended.

entries.name: Dedicated Frontline Tank
entries.text: Any hero filling the frontmost position reliably receives the White piece designation - damage received reduced. A proper tank absorbs the early burst that would otherwise threaten the board-presence threshold Jiutian's Ultimate relies on to stay in Execute mode.

entries.name: Energy Accelerators (e.g. Caishen)
entries.text: Faster team Energy cycles mean more Ultimate casts, more stance switches, and more Tactical Interception procs per fight. Each additional Ultimate cast also creates another opportunity to set the optimal stance for the current board state.

entries.name: Clubs Faction Stack
entries.text: CN posts consistently place Jiutian in Clubs faction (梅花) teams. The faction bonus grants team-wide ATK and HP at 3-5 member thresholds - directly amplifying Execute stance ramp damage and improving survivability for Enter the Game conversion cycles.

playstyle: Jiutian Xuannv rewards players who treat her like a chess player rather than a damage dealer. Her value is not in holding a button - it is in ensuring the frontmost and rearmost slots are intentionally filled, the team runs long enough for her energy drain and stance cycling to compound, and the Ultimate is cast at the right moment to set the correct stance for the fight phase.

In longer PvE content - Clubs Tower, push stages, high-damage boss rankings - this design flourishes. In short burst PvP environments the return on mechanical investment is lower. She is most rewarding for players who understand their team's positional structure and are building toward Clubs faction synergies.

The honest CN verdict: strong but not idiot-proof. She is not a plug-and-play carry. She is a board-control archer whose ceiling is high and whose floor depends entirely on how well her positioning and team structure are constructed around her kit.
